request.deadline: 18 months of operations including transition; milestones run from Q3 2026 through 2027
deliverables: Not-for-profit entity legally established or host-organization agreement signed under a preliminary board in Q3 2026
Technical transition architecture and migration plan published for community review in Q3 2026
Public usage dashboard live in Q3 2026
Board election held via on-chain voting under public rules in Q4 2026
Newly elected board formally assumes its mandate from the preliminary board in Q4 2026
All public API traffic for mainnet, preview, and preprod served by the new stack in Q1 2027
Blockfrost source code, trademarks, domain names, and associated assets legally transferred to the governing entity in Q1 2027
Public sustainability consultation and proposal published in Q2-Q3 2027
Public API operated at minimum 99% monthly uptime with quarterly technical and budget reports during 2027
request.recipient: Input Output / Blockfrost transition under legal contract with Cardano Development Holdings administered by Intersect
request.what: Fund an 18-month transition of Blockfrost into a free, community-governed not-for-profit public API for Cardano, including operations during the transition.

claims.claim: Blockfrost is described as a hosted REST interface that lets developers read from and interact with Cardano without running their own node.
The proposal states that Blockfrost developer-survey usage grew from 39.3% in 2022 to 71.5% in 2025, citing Cardano Foundation survey links for each year.
The proposal states that Blockfrost served 781k unique visitors, more than 1.84 billion API requests, almost 700 requests per second, and over 7 TB of API data last month.
The proposal states that in most Cardano epochs more than 50% of all transactions are submitted through Blockfrost.
The proposal states that more than 100 Icebreakers have joined the decentralized Blockfrost operator effort.
The proposal commits to transferring all Blockfrost intellectual property, including source code, trademarks, domain names, and associated assets, to the governing not-for-profit entity.

The proposed governance model includes a five-seat board with four open-source infrastructure entity seats and one community seat, with elections hoped for by year-end and board appointment no later than Q1 2027.
The budget requests 9,832,979 ADA, calculated as 1,868,266 USD at 0.19 USD per ADA, with 79.1% for staffing, 19.3% for operations and infrastructure, and 1.6% for legal and accounting.
The proposal states that long-term sustainability may come from paid not-for-profit commercial tiers or vendor membership fees, with future profits returned to the Cardano Treasury.

The proposal states that quarterly reports, public dashboards, third-party assurance, Intersect delivery assurance, and smart-contract-based treasury management will provide monitoring and accountability.

summary: The document requests 9,832,979 ADA to move Blockfrost from a commercial service into a community-governed not-for-profit public API over 18 months, with milestones for entity setup, board election, service migration, IP transfer, sustained operations, dashboards, reporting, and assurance.
